import re
# Double sign prefix (what is_numeric would do)
pattern = r'[-+]?' + r'[-+]?\d{1,3}(?:[,_]\d{3})*\.\d+|[-+]?\d+\.\d*|[-+]?.?\d+'
tests = ['-.121', '.121', '-12.1', '12.0']
for t in tests:
    m = re.match(pattern + '$', t)
    print(f'{t!r}: {\"match: \" + m.group() if m else \"no match\"}')
"
